utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only caught scraps so far—what jobs are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the basics are covered—leaky faucets, squeaky doors, and small patch-up jobs people’ve been putting off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s helpful — what’s still open, then?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I'm happy to help however you need. What would be most useful for me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you help me keep track of which homes are done and which still need a visit?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can keep the home list updated and mark each visit as it’s done. Just let me know how you want me to track it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send it over when I can. I’d definitely appreciate the reminder if I forget.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll give you a friendly nudge if needed, and I’ll keep a few basics ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just keep me posted when the plan’s clearer, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted and repeat the plan once it’s clearer, so you’ll know exactly where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’m still a bit fuzzy, but once you’ve got the details sorted, I’ll be ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep tracking the supplies and note any gaps as you get the repair list together. Just send me the fixes, and I’ll match what we have to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll follow the repair drive details exactly and flag any gaps before you start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll follow the repair drive details exactly and flag any gaps before we start. Send me the list, and I’ll keep track of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll keep spreading the word and ask a few more neighbors to stop by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Quinn—every extra set of hands helps. I should be by after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—just swing by whenever you’re done, Ira, and I’ll make sure folks know to expect you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can send the date, time, and drop-off spot if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — having the date, time, and drop-off spot in one place would help a lot. And if there’s a sign-in sheet, that’d make tracking everything much easier.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll send the date, time, drop-off spot, and a sign-in sheet if we’re using one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word to my friends and point them your way to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — that’d be really helpful. If you hear back, I can sort the sign-ups by house or by repair type.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll send anyone who’s interested your way, and you can sort them from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the date, time, and a short tools list in a moment so you can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and come by ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’ll send the details shortly and we’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check with folks and see if they’ve got a sign-in sheet going yet. It’s sounding like a pretty strong turnout already!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s great to hear, Tess. Thank you for checking on that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem — I’ll ask around and report back if I find where they’re keeping track. It’s nice to see so many people showing up for it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we got enough people for the afternoon shift, or do I need to line up a few more volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll check the afternoon roster, and if we’re short I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli—please do, and tell me straight if we need more people.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll keep it to the repair drive details and focus on the brakes and tires.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive details and help however I can with brakes and tires.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it simple and just follow the repair drive details for the brakes and tires.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll ask around this afternoon and let folks know to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll stick to the repair drive details exactly?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll stick to the repair drive details exactly and just pass them along as planned.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in for this afternoon — I can swing by after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll swing by later and keep repeating the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll head over once I’m done with my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep it simple and send over a short tool list so we can get this repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, send it over when you can—I’ll be ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rey—I’ll write up the short list and send it along soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—should I sort the repair list by house or by repair type?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Repair type would be easiest for me—then I can line it up around pickup and dinner times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Repair type works for me—I’ll group the list that way and keep it simple around pickup and dinner times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m just following the repair drive details exactly—mainly checking the brakes and tires so it’s safe for school runs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — so it’s mostly brakes and tires for safety? I’ve only caught scraps, so that’s really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going well so far—most of the jobs are covered, but we could still use a few extra hands this weekend. I can fill you in on what’s already set if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, fill me in — I can help with the leftover basics this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Dane — I’ll tell you what’s still open and put you down for the basics this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — can you send me the date and drop-off spot again? I’ll probably forget if I don’t write it down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I’ll send the date and drop-off spot again, but please jot it down so it doesn’t get lost. We really need everything tracked cleanly for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — I’ll write it down this time so I don’t lose it again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—could you help me keep track of which homes are done and which ones still need a stop?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help track that. Send me the list, and I’ll mark done versus still pending.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo—I'll send the list as I go, and please keep me posted on any homes that still need a stop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That means a lot, Sam. I’m grateful for the help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Uli — I’m glad to help. Just let me know what you need checked or tracked on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll make a short list of what needs checking and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are lining up stuff for it already — seems like a really good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s great to hear — do we have enough people covered for the afternoon shift?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not sure yet, but I’ll ask around and see if anyone can fill the afternoon shift.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still piecing the repair drive together, but I’ll pass along the list as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of any gaps in supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll send the list over as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can bring by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send you the list as soon as I’ve got it together. Appreciate you pitching in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out for your list and have a few basics ready for the repair drive.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
